about.title: Since 1972, one name has stood behind the shelves of the Kingdom.
about.storyP1: For over fifty years, Bafail Group has delivered without interruption — building one of the most extensive distribution operations in the Kingdom, from the ground up. We don't chase attention. We distribute the brands that Saudi households already trust, backed by the systems, standards, and discipline that keep every shipment on time and every shelf stocked.
about.storyP2: That discipline shows in the scale we've built: more principals, more categories, more cities reached every year. It shows in the retailers and wholesalers across the Kingdom who keep choosing Bafail, order after order. Our reputation isn't built on noise — it's built on five decades of reliable delivery and the values that make us one of the most trusted names in the business.
about.missionTitle: To be the first name every global and local brand trusts when entering the Saudi market — present in every channel, across the Kingdom.
